title: Baobab CMS Content Type blueprint
description: Schema for a Content Type blueprint (spec 02 §1.2, §9). Describes a Content Type's identity, fields and relations independently of the generated module — spec reference: docs/specs/specification-content-types.md.

key.description: Technical key, English singular PascalCase (spec 02 §9 decision 3).

label.description: Displayed label, translatable and independent from the key (spec 02 §4.1).

is_addressable.description: Whether this Content Type has public front URLs (spec 02 §4.3).

title_field.description: Key of a text/textarea/richtext field used to auto-generate the slug in the admin form (spec 02 §4.2) — required when is_addressable is true, cross-checked at runtime against fields[] by ContentTypeBlueprint.

url_prefix.description: Public URL prefix for this Content Type (spec 07 §3, spec 03 §3 pipeline) — routes as /{url_prefix}/{slug}. Only meaningful when is_addressable is true. Defaults to the kebab-plural of the key when absent, cross-checked at runtime against reserved prefixes and other addressable types by ContentTypeBlueprint.

workflow.description: Activates the single-level validation workflow (submit/pending/approve/reject transitions, spec 09 §5). Off by default: the type only has the direct draft/published/scheduled/archived transitions.

unpublish_at.description: Whether this type carries the optional unpublish_at convention column (scheduled auto-archive, spec 09 §4). On by default; set to false to opt a type out.

public_api_read.description: Whether published entries of this (addressable) type are readable via REST/GraphQL without authentication (spec 08 §2.3). On by default — a public site already exposes this data in HTML; set to false to require an authenticated, permitted actor even for published entries.

revisions.description: Revision behaviour override for this type (spec 09 §6, spec 02 §9 decision 4). Omit to use the global default (baobab.content.revisions_limit).

limit.description: Revisions kept per entry beyond which the oldest are purged. 0 disables revisions for this type. null (omitted) falls back to the global default.

except.description: Field keys excluded from the revision snapshot.

blueprint_version.description: Blueprint format version (spec 01 §7.1 decision 5) — not to be confused with the per-type evolution counter (spec 02 §2.2), which lives on the content_types.version column.

fields.description: Field catalogue, validated against Baobab\ContentTypes\Fields\FieldRegistry at runtime (M3 point 2) — `type` must be a registered key, `options` must satisfy that type's optionsRules().

type.description: Field type key, checked against the FieldRegistry — not a fixed enum here so modules can register their own types.

default.description: Default value, shape depends on the field type.

exposed_in_api.description: Whether this field is serialized in REST/GraphQL responses and eligible as a ?filter[]/?sort= target (spec 02 §3, spec 08 §2.1). On by default — a field opts out explicitly rather than needing every existing blueprint updated to opt in.

options.description: Type-specific options (e.g. max_length for text, choices for select) — see each FieldType::optionsRules().

renamed_from.description: Previous field key, when this field is the result of a rename (spec 02 §2.2, M3 point 4). Consumed by BlueprintDiffer at evolution time, then kept as a permanent rename history entry for import/export.

seo.description: Extension SEO optionnelle du blueprint (spec 07 §7) — mapping schema.org consommé par Baobab\Seo\Actions\ComposeJsonLd, cross-vérifié à la validation (jetons {champ} de properties) par ContentTypeBlueprint::validateSeoSchema().

type.description: Type schema.org (Article, Product, Event, Recipe, JobPosting...) — non contraint par un enum fermé, tout type schema.org valide est accepté.

properties.description: Correspondance propriété schema.org -> jeton {champ} ou {title}, valeurs scalaires ou objets imbriqués (ex. offers.price).

relations.description: Relation catalogue, validated at runtime against Baobab\ContentTypes\Relations\RelationType and RelationTargetResolver (M3 point 3).

target.description: Another Content Type's key, or a known Core model (e.g. User) — resolved by RelationTargetResolver.
